capabilities: Browse slash tags as a hierarchical tree with collapse and expand
Explore tracked frontmatter properties with value sub-categories
Show notes matching the selected tag or property beside the selection
Pin tags, properties and notes for quick access
Create a new note from the selected tag or property via hotkey
extras: The marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's tag browsing is a flat list, so users with deep slash tags and property-based organization need a hierarchical way to explore tags, properties and their notes.
summary: Tag and property explorer that turns slash tags into a navigable tree, tracks frontmatter properties, and lists matching notes in a split view.
